# FiniteCounts.SubsetIncidence

**有限support的incidence与overlap**

证明有限等长support中固定site的真实计数与概率、给定support的真实交叠集合union bound和固定arity平方除n界。

**边界**：只处理有限组合计数，不从概率自动推导量子动力学误差或独立性。

**覆盖等级**：B+

## 声明

| FQN | 种类 | 源码 | 一句话 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Qatlib.Foundations.FiniteCounts.SubsetIncidence.incidentSupports` | def | L49 | The size-`r` subsets of `Fin n` that contain the element `a`. |
| `Qatlib.Foundations.FiniteCounts.SubsetIncidence.incidentSupports_card` | theorem | L53 | For positive `r`, the number of size-`r` subsets containing `a` is `Nat.choose (n-1) (r-1)`. |
| `Qatlib.Foundations.FiniteCounts.SubsetIncidence.incidentSupports_fraction` | theorem | L60 | For `0 < r ≤ n`, the fraction of size-`r` subsets containing a fixed element is `r / n`. |
| `Qatlib.Foundations.FiniteCounts.SubsetIncidence.overlappingSupports` | def | L75 | The size-`r` subsets of `Fin n` that intersect the support `s`. |
| `Qatlib.Foundations.FiniteCounts.SubsetIncidence.overlappingSupports_union` | theorem | L79 | The subsets overlapping `s` form the union of the incidence sets of its elements. |
| `Qatlib.Foundations.FiniteCounts.SubsetIncidence.overlappingSupports_card_le` | theorem | L87 | For positive `r`, at most `s.card * Nat.choose (n-1) (r-1)` size-`r` subsets overlap `s`. |
| `Qatlib.Foundations.FiniteCounts.SubsetIncidence.overlappingSupports_fraction_le` | theorem | L96 | For `0 < r ≤ n`, the fraction of size-`r` subsets overlapping `s` is at most `s.card * r / n`. |
| `Qatlib.Foundations.FiniteCounts.SubsetIncidence.fixed_arity_overlap_fraction` | theorem | L112 | For `0 < r ≤ n` and a support of size `r`, the fraction of size-`r` subsets overlapping that support is at most `r² / n`. |
